title: Two different people share the name Alex Kim; the ledger must keep two subjects
notes: Ground truth is the subject binding the actor declared. The failure this fixture catches is entity conflation: collapsing both observations onto one subject because the display name matches. No fixture line can prove the system did not merge them elsewhere, but a merge would show up as a second claim on the same subject, which expect_claim would then fail to match and expect_conflict would.
